title: GARD Assembly Preview
description: A GARD assembly drawn as lipids in water, gathering, taking molecules in and letting them go, and splitting in two, as the run its entry names plays (marked on the page: an example of invented numbers, or a development run of the engine): the origin-of-life view of the Cells map, standing alone.
stamp: {runs.0.data.example.says||runs.0.data.development.says}. The lipids, the water and how they move are the picture's own: no law of Cells computes how the lipids move and pack. GARD in Cells' engine: {entry.modelled.state}.
